updates.note: Management stated total capex spend for the year will be around INR 3,500 crore.
updates.quote: As Mr. Upadhyay mentioned that we'll be doing about INR 3,500 crore of capex during this year.

updates.note: Polycarbonate commissioning postponed to H2 FY29 (2028-2029).
updates.quote: I would anticipate that we would target H2 for our polycarbonate commissioning... Yes, FY28-29.

updates.note: Management confirmed MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone commissioning in August/Q2.
updates.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.
